name: Holding Each Other Accountable
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of mutual accountability among believers as a means of spiritual growth and restoration. Proverbs 27:17 illustrates how friends sharpen one another, while Ecclesiastes 4:9 highlights the strength found in partnership. Christ's teaching in Matthew 18:15 and Luke 17:3 instructs believers to lovingly confront and forgive one another when faults occur. Additionally, Romans 14:12 reminds each person that they ultimately give an account to God, and Galatians 6:1 calls for restoring those caught in sin with gentleness and humility.
